title: Menu section tree and menu context — memory-only

container.notes: MEMORY-ONLY (runtime). Menu section nodes linked by parent/child/sibling pointers; roots reached from menu globals ([0x01FD4948] auto-pause section, MRP pack list 0x0209AC60, [0x0209BE80], [0x02B47730]). Menu context at [0x0209AC30].

roundTrip: Memory-only; nothing persists. Edit positions/sizes/alpha in place.
Never write the call pointers (+0x00/+0x08) or the tree pointers; use the game's own hide/show/unload routines.
Persist layout changes in the MRP (group/entry x/y/width/height) instead.
gaps: Exact widths of childCount, unloadOrder, identifier; offset of Active Time; the border folder layout.
menuContext: everything except the three fields listed.
